A.label: Plan A: DSA-00264 corrected fill
A.description: 7 epochs in the Euclid/HSC footprint and in the Galactic plane and bulge; the remaining pointings go to the wide area where they add the most 5σ detections, with at least 2 epochs everywhere. Uses all 64,250 pointings.

B.label: Plan B: uniform Euclid/HSC depth
B.description: As Plan A, but the Euclid/HSC tiles share the same total time so that every tile there reaches the same final noise.

C.label: Plan C: maximum detections
C.description: At least 2 epochs everywhere and 7 in the Galactic plane and bulge; all remaining time goes wherever it adds the most 5σ detections.

fig1.label: Reference plan: depth by declination
fig1.description: 7 epochs in the Euclid/HSC footprint and the Galactic plane and bulge; 4, 3 or 2 by declination elsewhere. Uses 63,110 of the 64,250 pointings.
